title: Energy Assistance Liaison Note: Pledge Lookback for Payment Arrangements Installments
content:
*Energy assistance liaison note — Payment Arrangements (Deferred Payment Agreements)*

**Pledges counted toward a tested installment.** Which energy assistance pledges are counted when an installment is tested as missed follows the household's circumstances on the member's Electric Service by Rate Schedule account on the day the miss is recorded:

1. where the service account carries an unexpired medical certificate on that day, the pledges counted are those recorded in the three months ending on that day;
2. where it carries no unexpired medical certificate but an outstanding disconnect notice, those recorded in the two months ending on that day;
3. where neither holds, those recorded in the month ending on that day.

A medical certificate is unexpired when its expiry date on the service account is the day the miss is recorded or later; a disconnect notice is outstanding when the service account shows a disconnect notice date. The pledges are those recorded on the service account, by their recording date.

| Unexpired medical certificate | Outstanding disconnect notice | Pledges counted |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | recorded in the 3 months ending on the day |
| yes | no | recorded in the 3 months ending on the day |
| no | yes | recorded in the 2 months ending on the day |
| no | no | recorded in the 1 month ending on the day |

**Hypothetical household:** a LIHEAP pledge recorded about seven weeks before the day the miss is recorded and a county emergency assistance pledge recorded two weeks before. Under line 1 or line 2 both pledges are counted; under line 3 only the county pledge is counted.
